system.description:
When you make an attack against a creature, you can choose to inflict them with the Mark of Death. This mark is the foundation of your other skills. Whenever you attack a new creature, you can choose to transfer your Mark of Death from the previous bearer to your new target.

Target: You can also use a Swift Action to point at a creature you can see and apply your Mark of Death to them. You can only do this once per phase.
